translation_notes: prefixes: ONTOUML->ontouml, RDF->rdf, RDFS->rdfs, XSD->xsd (RDF/RDFS/XSD/Graph/Literal/Namespace stay imported but unused by this region's own body, mirroring original.py's own unused imports).

`text_shape_uri = URIRef(BASE_URI + "view-1_shape")` -> `f<{BASE_URI}view-1_shape>` (the 'term_constructor: 1' category): no @base is in scope, so this is a plain formatted-IRI concatenation, exactly matching URIRef(str + str) with no percent-encoding on either side.

the three read assertions, each the stratum's own idiom: `(text_shape_uri, RDF.type, ONTOUML.Text) in ontouml_graph` -> `bool(m{ {text_shape_uri} a ontouml:Text })` (a fully-ground pattern, no variable at all -- confirmed the transpiler accepts this, compiling to a zero-arity match); `not any(ontouml_graph.triples((text_shape_uri, ONTOUML.text, None)))` and the ONTOUML.value sibling -> `not bool(m{ {text_shape_uri} ontouml:text [] })` / `... ontouml:value [] })`, `[]` as the non-distinguished (matched, not projected) object, per how-to/migrate-from-rdflib.md.

`from ..decode import decode_ontouml_json2graph, write_graph_file` and `from ..modules.text_values import UnsupportedTextValueWarning` are relative imports into the ontouml-json2graph PACKAGE itself: they cannot resolve once this region is extracted to a standalone file (no parent package). context_shim.py stands in for both, plus `write_text_shape_project` (a sibling test helper defined earlier in the same test_main.py, not part of this region's own lines) -- same shim-instead-of-running-the-real-pipeline convention as the trav_existence sibling `test_cli_default_writes_no_metadata_or_sidecar` in this repository: the region is graded on its own three read assertions, not on the whole JSON->RDF decoder. `write_graph_file` (imported but never called by this region) is a NotImplementedError stub; `UnsupportedTextValueWarning` is transcribed verbatim so `warnings.simplefilter("error", ...)` arms a real warning class.

the shim's decode_ontouml_json2graph reads a `_fixture_name` marker file the driver drops next to the JSON input, and copies the named Turtle fixture into a fresh graph instead of running the real decoder -- same marker-file mechanism as the sibling shim.

demo() harness (identical both sides, see meta.json), same convention as the sibling: the region is a pytest test that only ever asserts, and the upstream test itself only ever exercises the all-pass path -- without demo() catching AssertionError, the FALSE side of any of the three `bool(m{ })` checks would never be observable by the oracle, since an uncaught assertion would abort the driver outright.

anti-hollow-green: broke each of the three assertions in turn (wrong rdf:type object; wrong predicate on the second and third checks) -- each break made rdfeval check FAIL on a different call index with a genuine 'ok' vs ('assertion-failed', ...) mismatch, confirming all three islands are independently exercised by the four fixtures rather than passing vacuously. Restored before finalising.
